lines.text: Standup is in five minutes. What are Ada and Ben's agents working on right now?
Nobody knows, so everyone asks, and everyone scrolls back through old chats to remember.
With Agent R Q, you share a workspace with your team, and that is all it takes.
Everyone sees its tasks live, with the owner's name on each one.
So standup is a glance at the board. Nothing to ask, and nobody to interrupt.
Filter by member, and see only what one teammate is doing.
Or switch to the board, with columns for waiting, ongoing, and done.
Open the analytics for the whole team, to see how many tasks were finished this week.
It is read-only. Teammates cannot reply, or approve anything on your behalf.
But if a task is useful, you can clone it into a workspace of your own.
The clone is a fresh task in your workspace, run by your own agent, with its own approvals.
Skip the status chat. See your team's tasks at Agent R Q dot com.
